# Duke Reynard

Reynard Aldrenne, Duke of Reynard, is the spymaster who wrote the letter
the party found. The duke's letter is not what it seems: it is a countersign.

The duke has three agents in Greymoor. Two of them the party has already
met and does not know are agents. The third is the toll-keeper.

The duke's letter asks for the pouch to be delivered — but the duke knows
the party will read it. The countersign inside is deliberately bait.

GM notes:
- The duke wants the party to take the fall for the garrison's smuggling.
- The duke's own agent is the toll-keeper.
- The duke's seal is a thistle. So is the spymaster's mark — the same
  person holds both titles, which the party may discover.

Related: [[The Duke's Letter]], [[The Toll Road]]
